steps.name: check-deps
steps.description: Verify t0106_long_pdnd_nsga2_300gen and t0112_t0106_seed77_replicate are completed (substrate + fork base).

steps.name: init-folders
steps.description: Create the mandatory task folder structure.

steps.name: research-papers
steps.description: Skipped: random-seed replicate of t0112; no new literature evidence is required beyond what t0106/t0112 already established.

steps.name: research-internet
steps.description: Skipped: no new external information needed for a random-seed replicate of t0112.

steps.name: research-code
steps.description: Review t0112 code (the fork base) and identify exactly what must be copied vs imported. Confirm the t0106 -> t0112 patch set is the right starting point.

steps.name: planning
steps.description: Write plan.md covering fork strategy from t0112, the single seed-constant change (T0112_SEEDS=(77,) -> T0113_SEEDS=(2247,)), smoke-gate checks, Vast.ai provisioning, $25 cost cap, and HV-plateau stop criterion.

steps.name: setup-machines
steps.description: Provision a single Vast.ai CPU instance matching t0106/t0112 provisioning class (EPYC, >=100GB RAM, dph<=0.40).

steps.name: implementation
steps.description: Fork t0112 code, apply the single seed-constant change (77 -> 2247), local smoke gate, remote NSGA-II run with HV-plateau stop, collect per-cell predictions asset.

steps.name: teardown
steps.description: Destroy the Vast.ai instance and finalise cost tracking.

steps.name: creative-thinking
steps.description: Skipped: random-seed replicate of t0112; alternative approaches would defeat the purpose of the like-for-like seed comparison.

steps.name: results
steps.description: Write results_summary.md, results_detailed.md, metrics.json, costs.json, charts comparing seed 2247 to seeds 44 (t0106) and 77 (t0112).

steps.name: compare-literature
steps.description: Compare seed-2247 DSI/PD frontier and joint-pass yield against t0106 (seed 44), t0112 (seed 77), and published DSGC ratio DSI / PD references.

steps.name: suggestions
steps.description: Write suggestions.json based on the three-seed substrate-rate outcome.

steps.name: reporting
steps.description: Run all verificators, capture sessions, update task.json status, push PR, pre-merge check, merge.
